about: INS Total cells the app serves directly (instead of a reconstruction): every geographic level, all years from `from`. Fetch with scripts/fetch-ins-reference-cells.py --spec app/data/published_totals.json, load into the generation's DB with scripts/load-published-totals.py. Recipes name the matrix in `published`. A query that keeps a dimension other than area, year and unit (for example sex) names it in `breakdown` ({name: position of the dimension in `select`}). `area` is the position of the area dimension when it is not the one just before the period, or false for a matrix without one (its rows are filed under area TOTAL). The table has one row per (matrix, area, period, breakdown); breakdown is '' when every other dimension is Total.
